title: Order creation endpoint returns 404 due to route typo
description: Automated integration tests for order creation are failing with 404 responses. The frontend and tests call /api/order/create, but backend route is registered as /api/orders/create.
steps_to_reproduce: Run integration test suite for order APIs
error_log:
POST /api/order/create 404 3.112 ms - 149
AssertionError: expected 201 "Created", got 404 "Not Found"
expected_behavior: Order creation endpoint responds with 201 and created order payload
actual_behavior: Request hits non-existent path and returns 404
recent_changes: Routes were reorganized to plural resource naming without updating all clients
